name: Harvey Davies

career_stints.note: League Two loan after signing a new Liverpool contract in June 2025. Strong start to the campaign but was dropped amid a poor run of results, and Liverpool exercised an option to recall him early in February 2026 (deadline day). Not called upon by Liverpool's first team after the recall.

notes: has_liverpool_minutes set to false: the only 'Liverpool debut' found in sources was a 2022 pre-season friendly (vs Crystal Palace, Singapore tour) plus unused first-team squad/bench inclusions (Champions League squad vs RB Leipzig/Real Madrid 2021, Community Shield bench 2022) -- none of these are senior competitive minutes, so they are not counted as has_liverpool_minutes or included as a career_stint.

Academy player at Liverpool since age nine; no confirmed senior competitive Liverpool appearances as of this profile's creation (2026-08-10), hence basis is prior_club_recent_minutes using his most recent loan (Crawley Town 2025/26) rather than liverpool_recent_minutes.
Reported as 'expected to' sign a new Liverpool contract extension as of early August 2026 (empireofthekop.com) -- not yet confirmed finalized at time of writing, not treated as fact here.
Confidence kept low (0.35): third/fourth-choice depth goalkeeper with no senior top-level appearances and a below-par loan spell that ended in an early recall.
Sources: liverpoolfc.com, thisisanfield.com, liverpool.com, anfieldwatch.co.uk, empireofthekop.com, onefootball.com, theoneglove.com -- via web search 2026-08-10.
